svg.title: Tibo Van Genechten — ship log
svg.desc: Tibo Van Genechten: OnShift, 1,743 commits; Academic Work, 1,599 commits. 4,852 contributions in the past year, 202 this week, 77-day streak. Languages: TypeScript 48%, Java 27%, Blade 13%, PHP 5%, C# 2%, Dart 2%. Contribution heatmap 368 days to 2026-10-28: 232 active days, longest streak 77 days, busiest week 431, busiest day 100, 63 repositories touched. Pushed in the last 14 days: tvgenechten, 6 commits; Academic Work, 80 commits; OnShift, 134 commits; private work, 2 commits.
